svg.text: Aromatics subcategory (S8a grouping, 60 genes; >=4 co-located; DATA-DRIVEN, not a cited operon): 1-/2-Methylnaphthalene, 2-Aminophenol, 2-Nitrobenzoate, 4-Hydroxyphenylacetate, Aniline, Anthranilate, Benzene, Biphenyl -- same grouping as Fig. S8a. Still spans several sub-pathways: pairwise check found boxB (Benzene/benzoyl-CoA box pathway) does not co-occur with the dominant xylZ/xylL/benA/xylY/benB (benzoate/toluate) cluster -- residual heterogeneity within this subcategory, much reduced from flat aromatics_full but not fully eliminated
